name: Akujo Densetsu II ~Sailor Fuku Rhapsody~
original_name: 悪女伝説 Ⅱ ～セーラー服ラプソディ～
source:
A nanpa game where the hero needs to get the girl interested, raise the affection level during conversation in a cafe, beat her in the blackjack card game and lead her to the hotel as a result.
